patthana12.2:1.1: Nahetuṃ naappaccayaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naappaccayo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ naappaccayaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu naappaccayo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ naappaccayaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naappaccayo ca nanahetu naappaccayo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. (3)
patthana12.2:2.1: Nanahetuṃ naappaccayaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu naappaccayo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nanahetuṃ naappaccayaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naappaccayo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nanahetuṃ naappaccayaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naappaccayo ca nanahetu naappaccayo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. (3)
patthana12.2:3.1: Nahetuṃ naappaccayañca nanahetuṃ naappaccayañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naappaccayo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ naappaccayañca nanahetuṃ naappaccayañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu naappaccayo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ naappaccayañca nanahetuṃ naappaccayañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naappaccayo ca nanahetu naappaccayo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. (3).
patthana12.2:11.1: Nahetuṃ nalokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ nalokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.2:12.1: Nahetuṃ nakenaci viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ nanakenaci viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
